class.name: VisionOSPlaneTracker
class.brief_description: A tracker for a plane detected by visionOS.
class.description: Exposes a flat surface ARKit detected in the user's surroundings, such as a floor, wall, table, or ceiling. Enable this with the [code]xr/visionos/scene_understanding/enable_plane_detection[/code] project setting. [member plane_alignment] tells you how the plane is oriented and [member plane_label] carries ARKit's semantic classification. ARKit refines planes as it scans, so connect to [signal mesh_changed] and re-fetch geometry rather than caching it.

method.name: clear_mesh_data
method.description: Clears the cached geometry for this plane.

method.name: get_mesh
method.description: Returns the plane's geometry as a [Mesh]. If ARKit supplied a detailed boundary polygon that is used, otherwise a quad of [member bounds_size] is returned. The mesh is built on first use and cached until the data changes.

method.name: get_mesh_offset
method.description: Returns the transform of the geometry returned by [method get_mesh] relative to this tracker's pose.

method.name: get_shape
method.description: Returns a collision shape matching this plane, extruded by [param thickness] metres so thin surfaces still collide reliably. The shape is built on first use and cached until the data changes.

method.name: set_mesh_data
method.description: Sets the plane's boundary geometry. This is normally called by the engine as ARKit reports updates.

members.member: The size of the plane's bounding rectangle, in metres.
How this plane is oriented in space.
ARKit's semantic classification for this plane, such as [code]floor[/code], [code]wall[/code], [code]table[/code], or [code]ceiling[/code]. Empty when ARKit has not classified it.

signal.name: mesh_changed
signal.description: Emitted when ARKit updates this plane's geometry. Any [Mesh] or [Shape3D] previously returned is now out of date.

constants.constant: A horizontal plane facing up, such as a floor or a table top.
A horizontal plane facing down, such as a ceiling.
A vertical plane, such as a wall.
A plane at an arbitrary angle.
